children: NRx Pharmaceuticals received FDA notice reclassifying its ANDA amendment as a Minor Amendment and setting a GDUFA goal date of November 10, 2026.
FDA reclassified NRx Pharmaceuticals' ANDA amendment from Major to Minor, per regulatory notice.
GDUFA goal date revised to November 10, 2026, signaling an expedited review timeline.
FDA stated the reclassified amendment will not require substantial expenditure of agency resources.
Company framed the change as advancing approval of its preservative-free ketamine product.
